sap.app.title: Overflow Toolbar - in a table and in the footer of a page
sap.app.description: Two OverflowToolbars: one as a Table headerToolbar with SearchField (NeverOverflow), sort/group/export OverflowToolbarMenuButton and filter/reset actions; one as a Page footer with Accept/Reject buttons (NeverOverflow) and icon-only OverflowToolbarButton/OverflowToolbarToggleButton for overflow. Table data is filtered/sorted/grouped through the controller.
